title: Edible And Easter Eggs
description: A mod that gives more possible uses for the egg.
body: This mod allows you to boil an egg by cooking it in a furnace, smoker, or over a fire. Once you have a boiled egg, you can dye it in any of the 16 vanilla colors by combining it with a dye. A boiled egg restores 6 hunger points (3 chicken‑drumsticks) regardless of its color.
